test_title: PYST 46 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has two blanks. Choose the most suitable set of prepositions from the given options to fill in the blanks and complete the sentence meaningfully:

The committee insisted ________ a thorough investigation before proceeding ________ any decision.
solution:
The correct answer is '**on, with**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The preposition "**on**" is used to indicate insistence or focus in the context of a subject or action (e.g., "insisted on a thorough investigation").
 
• The preposition "**with**" is appropriate when referring to proceeding or continuing in relation to something (e.g., "proceeding with any decision").
 
• Other options (e.g., "in, by," "of, to," and "to, under") do not fit logically or grammatically in the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"The committee insisted **on**__ a thorough investigation before proceeding __**with**__ any decision."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "in, by"** is incorrect because "insisted in" and "proceeding by" are not suitable phrases for this context.
 
• **Option 3: "of, to"** is incorrect because "insisted of" and "proceeding to" are not grammatically correct in this sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "to, under"** is incorrect because "insisted to" and "proceeding under" do not fit the context of the sentence.
